title: AS2 classes P0: model + .fla persistence foundation (asClasses/classpaths) — preserve Flash 8 export
description: DONE (Phase 0). Model: added optional FlashDocument.asClasses (readonly AsClassFile[] {path,source}) + classpaths (readonly string[]). New AsClassFile type. fla/zip.ts: saveFla writes each class as classes/<path> entry AND keeps asClasses inline in document.json; loadFla prefers zip entries (authoritative) else inline, defaults classpaths to ['.'] when classes present, leaves both UNSET for class-free docs (byte-identical to pre-AS2). SCHEMA_VERSION 1->2 (CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION too). Mutations addAsClass(upsert)/updateAsClass(no-op if absent)/removeAsClass, immutable+history-safe, exported. Flash8 binary export UNAFFECTED: saveRealFla ignores asClasses (test asserts byte-identical output with vs without classes). Tests: new asclasses-roundtrip.test.ts (17 tests, all green) covering zip round-trip, classpaths default, zip-wins-over-inline, inline fallback, unset-for-class-free, byte-identical no-regression, saveRealFla unaffected, all 3 mutations + mutation round-trip. Build green (all 7 packages). core: 5340 passed, only 3 pre-existing missing-fixture failures (carchive-validate/contents-structure/empty-bytematch all ENOENT flash8-empty.fla, not committed in this checkout). authoring-ui: 825 passed. Exported API: type AsClassFile {readonly path:string; readonly source:string}; FlashDocument.asClasses?, .classpaths?; addAsClass(doc,file:AsClassFile):FlashDocument; updateAsClass(doc,path:string,source:string):FlashDocument; removeAsClass(doc,path:string):FlashDocument — all via @flash/core.
